tha-ap462:1.1: Gandhapūjaka.] Citesu kiramānesu nānāgandhe samāgate / pasannacitto sumano gandhamuṭṭhim apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap462:2.1: Satasahasse ito kappe citakaṃ yam apūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi citapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap462:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Gandhapūjako thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap462:10.1: Jagatī Morahatthī ca Āsanī Ukkadhārako Akkamī Vanakoraṇḍī Chattado Jātipūjako
tha-ap462:11.1: Sattipaṇṇī ca yo thero dasamo Gandhapūjako sattasaṭṭhī ca gāthāyo gaṇitāyo vibhāvihi.
